map.纠错级别 L/M/Q/H 可恢复约 7%/15%/25%/30% 破损；URL: Error correction levels L/M/Q/H recover about 7%/15%/25%/30% damage; URL is byte mode, shorter is easier to scan.
map.容量（字节模式，纠错 M）：V1 ≈ 14 字符 … V40 ≈ 2331 字符: Capacity (byte mode, EC M): V1 ≈ 14 chars … V40 ≈ 2331 chars
map.建议：纠错等级 M（可恢复约 15% 码字）: Suggestion: error correction level M (recovers about 15% of codewords)
map.网址二维码把 URL 以字节/字母数字模式编码进矩阵，扫码后由系统交给浏览器打开: A URL QR code encodes the URL in byte/alphanumeric mode into a matrix; after scanning, the system hands it to the browser to open. Practical points: prefer a short link to shorten the URL — the longer the URL, the higher the QR version and module density, requiring larger print size and higher scan precision; error correction level M is recommended (~15% recovery), tolerating smudges without over-dense modules; the protocol header (http/https) must be validated — a missing protocol is recognized as plain text and won't redirect; leave a quiet zone (blank margin) of at least 4 modules around the printed code.
map.把活动落地页做成二维码印在物料上，用户扫码直达，省去在手机上敲长地址。: Make an event landing page into a QR code printed on materials; users scan to go directly, avoiding typing a long address on a phone.
map.长链接用短链更好吗？: Is a short link better for long URLs?
map.是，过长会降低密度与识别率。: Yes, too long lowers density and recognition.
map.为什么扫出来提示不安全？: Why does scanning warn it's unsafe?
map.多半是链接用了 http 而非 https：浏览器会拦截或标记，用户也可能因警告: Mostly the link uses http rather than https: the browser blocks or flags it, and users may give up out of warning. Also if any hop in the short-link chain is http, the same warning triggers. Before publishing, confirm the entire redirect chain is HTTPS end-to-end and scan-verify the final landing page.
map.URL 二维码。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: URL QR Code. Built for developers, runs purely in the frontend; your code never leaves the browser.
